editorial:
Imagine being a hardworking guy who does a huge favor for his boss, only to get stabbed in the back. That is exactly what happens to Abo Dahab. He is just a simple baker who takes the fall and goes to prison to protect his employer. When he finally walks out of those gates, he thinks his life will be better, but he finds out his boss lied about taking care of his family. You can really feel his anger when he snaps and loses his job. It is a gritty story about a good man who gets pushed too far and decides to play a dangerous game just to survive.

The acting feels very real, and you will find yourself rooting for him even when he starts doing bad things. The way he goes from a humble baker to a crime boss is a wild ride that keeps you interested. While some parts of the movie move a bit slow, the tension makes up for it. If you enjoy crime dramas with a lot of heart, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the details, or just stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a cozy night in.
endingExplained: After working for Haridi, Abo Dahab realizes that the only way to truly win is to remove the person at the top. He kills Haridi in a bold move to take over the entire drug business. Instead of going back to being a poor baker, he uses his new power and money to become the richest dealer in town. He gets the wealth he wanted, but he loses his innocence along the way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about revenge and rags-to-riches crime tales.
